base_rate_evidence: dataset/docs/SIMULATION_DESIGN.md: Calibration targets and sources; package reference values, not independently verified field calibration
limitations: All numeric modifiers, delivery lengths and stress ranges are explicit prototype assumptions, not fitted or literature-derived coefficients
Annual precipitation ratio is not runoff and omits timing and snowmelt processes
N application intensity is not N surplus; no crop nutrient-removal or fixation model is claimed
No quantified buffer, catch-crop or drainage effects are assigned
Stress ranges and donor spread are not calibrated probability intervals
No monitoring, public development loads or hidden truth were used for calibration
